per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall respond to parts search queries within 15 seconds.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The search for recycled parts shall take no longer than 15 seconds. The search results shall be returned in under 15 seconds.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall respond to facility search queries within 8 seconds.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The search for the preferred repair facility shall take no longer than 8 seconds. The preferred repair facility is returned within 8 seconds'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall generate audit reports within 10 seconds.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The recycled parts audit report shall be returned to the user within 10 seconds. The audit report shall be returned within 10 seconds.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall provide help functionality on at least 90% of screens.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The user shall easily locate instructions while using the product. User help can be found within 90% of the system.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall require no more than 2 days of onsite training for users to become comfortable.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall be easy to learn by Adjusters and Collision Estimators. The product shall be learned with two days onsite training'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall integrate directly with the Choice Parts feed.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall interface with the Choice Parts System. This provides the feed of recycled parts data.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall maintain an uptime of at least 98%.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall achieve a 98% uptime. The product shall not fail more than 2% of the available online time.'
